import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('project.py'); s = p.read_text()
old = '''def partition_batches(ids: list[str], batch_size: int) -> list[list[str]]:
    ...
'''
new = '''def partition_batches(ids: list[str], batch_size: int) -> list[list[str]]:
    return [ids[i:i + batch_size] for i in range(0, len(ids), batch_size)]
'''
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
print(p.read_text())
